component.name: MT Verdant Nocturne GTK3 theme
component.summary: Quiet charcoal-teal dark theme for GTK3 Flatpak apps

description.p: GTK3 theme extension so sandboxed Flatpak apps follow the MT Verdant Nocturne desktop theme. Installed automatically when the host GTK theme is set to MT-Verdant-Nocturne.
Complete Botanical Canopy desktop ecosystem with 100+ native application icons, floating island top bar styling, and refined controls.
Initial packaging of the GTK3 theme.
